channel.title: Ugur Tarlig
channel.description: Enterprise architecture and GenAI platform delivery for regulated industries.

item.title: AI liability is an architecture problem
item.description: Why chatbot output in customer-facing processes can't be treated as a side effect: an OLG Hamm ruling shows that guardrails, source grounding, human-in-the-loop, traces, and evals don't belong in phase 2.

item.title: The gap between agentic AI and enterprise reality
item.description: What roughly 40 self-built tools reveal about the real AI adoption gap: the bottleneck isn't the model, it's problem understanding, ownership, governance, measurability, and controlled execution.

item.title: An architect, but hands-on: what an AI Solutions Architect actually does
item.description: Not a role taxonomy, but the concrete work: start from the workflow, decide build vs. buy, draw data boundaries, build the MVP, integrate with the real organization, and ship to production.
